description: This file declares APIs for configuring UDP Echo diagnostics in a device, including setting enable flags, interface paths, and UDP ports, as part of TR-069 device management.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UDPEchoConfig_Enable
methods.description: Sets the enable flag for UDP Echo on the device.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UDPEchoConfig_Interface
methods.description: Sets the IP-layer interface over which the device listens for UDP echo requests.

methods.name: set_Device_IP_Diagnostics_UDPEchoConfig_UDPPort
methods.description: Sets the UDP port for the UDP Echo service.
